name: Shishi
subtitle: Jade Protector
description: Protect the kingdom from invaders as you charge into battle with your allies by your side.
lore: The shishi are great lions, sculpted of stone or metal, and granted life to serve as guardians of temples, shrines, and other holy sites. They possess intelligence and will far greater than the beasts they were made to resemble. Shishi have spread since the Shattering, as some now consider all Tian holy—or at least, significant enough to defend against outsiders.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when hit by an enemy.
